summary: SiteDocument is an entity representing documents associated with a Site in a system. It primarily provides structure for referencing document IDs and associated Site IDs, and is used by the application for document management and display.
purpose: To model the relationship between a document and a site, enabling storage and retrieval of site documents.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site document.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the site to which the document belongs.
